items.name: Hartnett Year Ahead 2027 (Thanksgiving week, in place of the weekly Flow Show): 7777 soft landing base, 6666 hard landing underpriced, 8888 bubble; preserve capital, GRAB hedges
items.headline: BofA's Hartnett on US Stocks in 2027: Full-Blown Bubble at 8888, Soft Landing at 7777, Hard Landing at 6666
items.claim: Three 2027 paths for the S&P 500: bubble/no landing ~8,888 (AI + government driven), soft-landing base case ~7,777 (breadth-driven, EPS growth ~10% vs 17% consensus), hard landing ~6,666 - the risk markets are least prepared for (only 3% of FMS respondents expect it; 50% soft, 42% no landing; FMS cash 3.6%). Preserve capital in the coming months while awaiting the spring rate-hike cycle and the dollar peak; BofA sees fed funds 4.50-4.75% by end-2027 (three hikes, no cuts). Once the narrative turns to cuts, buy cyclical 'C' assets (chips, commodities, crypto, consumer); hedge now with 'GRAB' (government bonds, real estate, AAA, bullion). Equity fund inflows a record $1.5tn annualised in 2026; investors broadly overweight stocks and commodities, underweight cash and bonds; K-shaped wealth effect and AI capex supports are weakening. Recession is not the base case (Goldilocks soft landing) but the hard landing is the biggest threat to consensus; 'play defense now' until fear is more visible.
items.source: Longbridge relay (Wallstreetcn) of BofA Hartnett Year Ahead 2027 note, 2026-11-27 02:17 UTC; TheStreet 2026-11-26 09:03 EST; tokenpost 63937 2026-11-27
items.note: This is the Year Ahead note, not a Flow Show with weekly EPFR flows; no weekly flow, Bull & Bear or YTD-by-asset figures beyond the 1.5tn annualised equity number were printed. Longbridge topic 45398471 (26 Nov) repeats the 20 Nov post-Thanksgiving-rebound stance (10y <4.5%, WTI <$70, dollar peak; 'likely Q2 next year'; ~2-week rebound) with snapshot 10y 4.855%, WTI 84.4, DXY 103.81. Year Ahead relays also cite a 2025 BofA projection of a bull-market peak ~Sep 2027 at 9,914.
